name: 52-options-refactor
prompt: In this module `norm.Normalize(s string) string` lowercases, collapses runs of whitespace and trims. Refactor it to `norm.Normalize(s string, opt norm.Options) string`, where `Options` is a struct with exported bool fields `Lower`, `Collapse` and `StripPunct`, and add `norm.Default() norm.Options` returning Lower and Collapse true and StripPunct false. Apply the steps in this order: StripPunct deletes every ASCII punctuation byte (the 32 in !"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~), then Collapse turns each run of whitespace into a single space, then Lower ASCII-lowercases; the ends are always trimmed, whatever the options. A zero Options therefore only trims. Then update every caller and every test in the module so `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass and the existing call sites behave exactly as they do today. Keep the existing test functions; do not delete tests.
